segments.1PE.1.3-5: God gives believers new birth and a living hope
segments.1PE.1.6-7: Trials test the faith of believers like fire tests gold
segments.1PE.1.11-12: Prophets foretold Christ’s sufferings and glory
segments.1PE.1.13-14: Believers should be alert and set hope on Jesus’ grace
segments.1PE.1.15-17: God is holy, so believers must be holy and respect him
segments.1PE.1.18-19: Christ’s blood, not silver or gold, set believers free
segments.1PE.1.20-21: Christ was known before creation and revealed for believers
segments.1PE.1.22-23: Believers are born again and must love one another
segments.1PE.1.24-25: God’s word stands forever, but people are like grass
segments.1PE.2.1-3: Believers must stop doing evil and crave spiritual milk
segments.1PE.2.4-5: Believers are living stones built into a spiritual house
segments.1PE.2.6-6: Scripture says God lays a chosen cornerstone in Zion
segments.1PE.2.7-8: The stone is precious to believers but makes others stumble
segments.1PE.2.9-10: Believers are God’s chosen people who have received mercy
segments.1PE.2.11-12: Believers as foreigners must live honorably among Gentiles
segments.1PE.2.13-17: Believers must obey rulers and honor everyone
segments.1PE.2.18-20: Slaves must respect masters, even when suffering unjustly
segments.1PE.2.21-23: Christ suffered without sin and left believers an example
segments.1PE.2.24-25: Christ bore our sins, and believers return to the Shepherd
segments.1PE.3.1-2: Wives should win unbelieving husbands by good behavior
segments.1PE.3.3-4: True beauty for wives is a gentle and quiet spirit
segments.1PE.3.5-6: Wives should follow Sarah, who hoped in God
segments.1PE.3.7-7: Husbands must treat wives with consideration and honor
segments.1PE.3.8-9: Believers should be humble and answer evil with blessing
segments.1PE.3.10-12: Believers must turn from evil, do good and seek peace
segments.1PE.3.13-13: No one can truly harm believers who do good
segments.1PE.3.14-14: Believers who suffer for doing right are blessed
segments.1PE.3.15-17: Believers should be ready to explain the hope gently
segments.1PE.3.18-20: Christ suffered once for sins and was made alive
segments.1PE.3.21-22: Baptism saves believers through Jesus’ resurrection
segments.1PE.4.1-2: Believers should live for God’s will, not human desires
segments.1PE.4.3-6: Believers have left the sinful life of the Gentiles
segments.1PE.4.7-9: Believers should pray, love each other and show hospitality
segments.1PE.4.10-11: Believers should use God’s gifts to serve each other
segments.1PE.4.12-14: Believers should not be surprised by suffering for Christ
segments.1PE.4.15-16: Believers should not be ashamed to suffer as Christians
segments.1PE.4.17-19: Believers who suffer should trust God and keep doing good
segments.1PE.5.5-7: Young men obey elders; all believers should be humble
segments.1PE.5.8-9: Believers must watch for the devil and resist him
segments.1PE.5.10-11: God will restore and strengthen believers after suffering
segments.1PE.5.12-14: Peter ends his letter with greetings and peace
